data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Experience → Baggage allowance → select cabin class) and names cabin class as the parameter, and its extra "read allowance table" step is harmless. It is slightly vague about how the cabin class is selected (a "tab" rather than a link), but a browser automation could still be built from it.
